ctx.x: ...and I wind up staying there 5½ years, you know, and the man never, did never win a poll as a group in his whole career, trio, and we hit the scene, you know, London House, and we started hitting all the places where the group performed,man, and everybody said man, that's the greatest trio, never sounded no better, we never, of course our style of playing, me and Louis Hayes see, Ed Thigpen, and Ray Brown.
